scope: 90 preselected wide rows, 10 per source-family/split cell; no test filtering or row replacement
selection_bias_note: 67/90 wide rows receive supervised labels. Failure counts vary across the nine preselected cells; full-run train masking and validation/test inventory must preserve all 23 failures and report their distribution. This pilot does not establish a population rate.
gate_reason: All 90 fixed rows and four calls per row completed under the frozen 30-minute cap; measured process peak RSS 80715776 bytes is below 4 GiB and the four thread controls were set to one before Python import. Candidate validation and source FK cross-check passed. No success-rate threshold was frozen, so missing labels are retained and measured rather than used to resample targets.
